projects.name: Professional Portfolio (Work in Progress)
activities: Developing a personal portfolio to showcase professional experience, technical expertise, and selected projects.

projects.name: SEO-Optimized Website for a Tattoo Removal Clinic
activities: Designed and developed a high-performance marketing website with an SEO-first approach, targeting tattoo removal searches across Guadalajara and the surrounding metropolitan area.
The platform generated measurable business impact, contributing to a 30% increase in revenue and a 50% increase in customer inquiries within the first six months of launch.
projects.achievements: Increase in revenue by 30% and customer inquiries by 50%.

projects.name: Custom CRM/ERP for a Tattoo Removal Clinic
activities: Architected and developed a custom business management platform that unified customer records, vendor information, inventory management, income and expense tracking, and operational reporting into a single system.

By automating manual processes and implementing business-specific workflows, the application improved operational efficiency, strengthened inventory and resource control, and enabled data-driven decision making through customer demographics and treatment analytics.
projects.achievements: Streamlined clinic operations by centralizing customer, inventory, and financial data into a single platform, reducing the risk of data loss while improving inventory control, expense tracking, and overall operational efficiency.

additionalActivities: Actively preparing for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification, with a focus on designing scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions on AWS.
Actively studying and focusing on the fundamentals: Data Structures, Algorithms, System Design.

Integrating AI development tools such as Claude Code and Gemini into the development workflow to improve productivity while ensuring code quality through testing, peer review, and engineering best practices.

projects.name: Conversation Intelligence Platform Integrations
activities: Designed and developed backend integrations with multiple video conferencing platforms for Salesloft's Conversation Intelligence product.

Built distributed, event-driven services using Node.js, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis as a queue with BullMQ, and Elasticsearch to process large volumes of asynchronous meeting data with high reliability, supporting a scalable platform for conversation analytics.
projects.achievements: Expanded the Conversation Intelligence ecosystem by integrating additional video conferencing providers, reducing adoption barriers and enabling more customers to analyze conversations from their preferred meeting platforms.

projects.name: Conversation Intelligence Platform Redesign
activities: Partnered with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, and Data Engineers to redesign and enhance the Conversation Intelligence platform.
Implemented end-to-end full-stack features, including advanced search, reusable search presets, clip exporting, and playlist management.
Designed new GraphQL resolvers and optimized Elasticsearch queries to enable retrieval of conversation recordings.
Leveraged Sentry for production monitoring, error investigation, and performance analysis, helping identify issues and validate application stability after deployments.
projects.achievements: By aligning the Conversation Intelligence platform with Salesloft's design system, created a more consistent and intuitive user experience that reduced friction and improved feature discoverability.

projects.name: Tech Lead – Salesloft Mobile App
activities: Led the technical execution of Salesloft's hybrid React Native application, partnering with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, and Customer Success to deliver new mobile features aligned with business needs.
Directed the development of new modules, improved application stability and maintainability, and ensured compliance with evolving Apple App Store and Google Play security requirements.
Improved and updated the CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions to build and deploy the new versions of the App for Apple App Store, and Google Play Store.
Designed and implemented Ruby on Rails API endpoints to extend web platform functionality to mobile clients, maintaining feature parity across platforms.
Regularly conducted code reviews on GitHub, contributed to architectural decisions, and mentored engineers to promote engineering best practices and high-quality software delivery.
projects.achievements: Increased the Salesloft Mobile App's Apple App Store rating from 2.5 to 3.9 stars within a few months by leading stability improvements, feature enhancements, and ongoing quality initiatives.

projects.name: Front-end Development – E-learning Platform
activities: Developed and maintained frontend features for an enterprise e-learning platform, implementing exportable reports and migrating legacy Angular modules to React as part of the platform modernization effort.
Collaborated with backend teams to integrate GraphQL and REST APIs, improving maintainability and the overall user experience.
projects.achievements: By modernizing legacy Angular modules and aligning them with the platform's React architecture, improved the user experience, reduced technical debt, and increased adoption of newly introduced platform features.

projects.name: Full Stack Development – E-learning Platform Forum
activities: Designed and developed a full-stack discussion forum that enabled learners to ask questions, participate in threaded discussions, vote on contributions, and report inappropriate content.
Built a scalable backend using GraphQL, Node.js, and AWS DynamoDB to support an engaging and collaborative learning experience.
projects.achievements: By delivering a scalable discussion platform, expanded the e-learning experience beyond video content, encouraging learner participation.

projects.name: Front-end Development – Legal News Platform
activities: Partnered with Product Managers to define and implement the redesign strategy for the legal division of a major news organization.
Developed a modern React and Redux application using the Foundation CSS framework, delivering an improved user experience while aligning the platform with updated business and usability requirements.
projects.achievements: Delivered a modernized user experience that aligned the platform with evolving business requirements, improving usability, navigation consistency, and user adoption while establishing a more maintainable frontend architecture.

projects.name: QA Automation Tools
activities: Designed and developed internal automation tools using Node.js, Express, and Puppeteer to streamline quality assurance workflows for a large Angular application. Automated repetitive testing tasks and browser interactions, reducing manual effort and enabling faster validation of application changes during development and release cycles.
projects.achievements: Reduced manual QA effort by automating repetitive testing workflows, accelerating validation cycles, improving test consistency, and enabling faster delivery of new application releases.
